notes.title: Patch 1.4.2
notes.notes:
Small patch with a few bugfixes for translation related things.
- In game achievements popup wasn't translating certain achievements
- In game challenge type collectables (travel fast, shoot 666 rockets etc) were not translating popups.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1
notes.notes:
- Added a few missing translations
- Made some small UI adjustments and fixes

notes.title: Localisations and speedrunning update (1.4.0)
notes.notes:
Localisation
- German localisation is complete
- Majority of Japanese localisation is complete.

Speedrunning
Completing the base game’s 40 levels will unlock speedrunning features, these are:
- Extra options under gameplay options for easier data management.
- Achievements will display in game when playing on data deleted through the options.

Other
- You can now restart on the end game screen with the shortcut button.

notes.title: Bug fixes (1.3.1)
notes.notes: - fixed a bug that would let you press multiple buttons on the end level screen causing the game to get stuck

notes.title: Free look update and single stick mode (1.3.0)
notes.notes:
Free look:
- The previous version of free look that was activated with bumpers has been removed.
- Shift (keyboard) / d-pad down (controller) now toggles a free look camera that you can fly around with movement/aim.
- Due to free look being remapped, the bumpers now also function as rocket and grapple.

Single stick mode:
- A new experimental feature in gameplay options will make the left stick both aim and move the character (invert rocket aim is flipped in this mode). A and X face buttons will fire rockets and grapples while in this mode.
- When switching single stick mode, a level restart is required for changes to take effect.

Bug fixes:
- Aim assist trying to lock on to air vents wind has been fixed.
- Leaderboard search time has been increased to avoid timing out on lower speed connections.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update / Medal Adjustments (1.1.0)
notes.notes:
GAMEPLAY CHANGES


 Level restarting has been overhauled to improve load times.
 Leaderboards are now visible in the pause menu.
 Thanks to the code changes for pause menu leaderboards, leaderboards will now load faster.
 An in-game attempts counter has been added! Can be toggled on in the gameplay options.
 Laser pointer visual has been adjusted so that the length now better suggest the grapple range.
 Laser colour can be changed in the gameplay options.
 Credits page adjustments.


DEMO


 All of the above changes are also in the demo
 Reworked the main menu to better represent the full game.
 Updated the starting plank in level 2 to make getting on the boxes easier.


LEVEL ADJUSTMENTS

In general the bronze medals have been made a little easier, mostly around 10-20% more time has been given. Any changes other than bronze will be listed under the specific level.
